turns.question: Which of 1 or 2 October 2026 had more precipitation in Amsterdam, and how many orders were placed by customers in the Netherlands on that day?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no precipitation or weather metric, so I cannot say which of 1 or 2 October 2026 was wetter; the closest metrics are only order-related. Orders placed by customers in the Netherlands (customer country NL, cancelled included) were 3 on 1 October 2026 and 3 on 2 October 2026, so the count is the same whichever day was wetter.
